title: New patient books a routine checkup, flexible on dates

persona.name: Maria Delgado
persona.style: warm, a bit chatty, says "oh perfect" when things work out

goals.goal: Say you're a new patient and want to book a routine checkup.
Take the first reasonable slot in the next two weeks; mornings are a little better.
Before hanging up, confirm the day and time back to them.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of Pretty Good How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi there! I'm a new patient and I'd like to book a routine checkup, please.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please provide your date of birth.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks, Maria. Just to confirm, you're a new patient and want to schedule a routine checkup. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I'd like to find the first available slot in the next two weeks, preferably in the morning if possible.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: There are several morning openings this Thursday, October fifteenth.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: With Abroker. At Tivot Point Orthopaedics. The earliest is at nine AM. Would you like to book that slot

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Oh perfect, yeah, nine AM this Thursday the fifteenth works for me. Could you please book that?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Your appointment is set for Thursday, October fifteenth at nine AM with doctor Adam Bricker at Pivot Point Orthopedics. Please bring your photo ID, insurance card, a list of your current medications, and any imaging discs you have.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to send you a text message with these details?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Thanks, but I think I'm good. Just to confirm, my appointment is Thursday at nine AM, October fifteenth with Dr. Bricker at Pivot Point Orthopedics, right?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: That's correct. Your appointment is Thursday. October fifteenth at nine AM with doctor Adam Bricker at Pivot Point Orthopedics. You're all set.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Great, thanks so much! Have a wonderful day. Bye!
